    New here? Do these 5 things

    1Claim FreebiesKafra in Prontera: 3 days VIP, costumes, potions, manuals. 2Type @ahYour character hunts by itself. 3 hours free every day. 3Type @wiWeapon Mastery grows as you hunt and makes you stronger. 4Type @dailyquest5 easy tasks a day for free headgears and potions. 5Join a partyEvery member gets their own roll on MVP drops.

    Item finder

    Type an item name or ID to see where to get it and what it costs. Covers every NPC shop (Tool Dealer, Pet Groomers, every town shop), the Quest Shop, Cash Shop, Gacha Machine, Daily / Hourly / Devil Square / PvP shops, and every monster drop with its drop rate on Legacia and the maps where that monster lives (VIP adds 50% to drop rates). For every NPC shop and town shop, see Shops.

    Getting started Prontera

    3 daysFree VIP from Freebies
    FreeHeal + buffs at Legacia Support
    AutoPlatinum skills on job change
    1. Kafra Employee (145,197) → Claim Freebies. Once per computer.
    2. Job Master (164,195) for job changes, Rebirth and Baby classes.
    3. Legacia Support (153,193, and in most towns) heals and buffs you for free.
    4. Warper stands in every town.
    Read more: what's in Freebies

    3 days of VIP, two random Poring costumes, 5 MVP Soul, 6 Light White Potion boxes, 6 Blue Potion boxes, 3 Battle Manuals and 3 JOB Battle Manuals.

    Episode 1: The Hollow Crown Preview

    Legacia's own story. A thousand years ago the kingdom of Legacia stood where Prontera is now, until King Aldric tried to make it eternal and tore it out of time. The Chronicle Stones that seal it are cracking, and rifts open into echoes of the lost kingdom.

    Base Lv 99Start at Archivist Sera, Prontera Castle (prt_castle 125,51)
    2 chaptersGlast Heim hunt, then a rift into an echo of Glast Heim
    Legacy ShardsTrade them for Legacia weapons and headgears
    10~20 shardsEvery day for clearing the rift again
    Read more: chapters, rewards and the Shard Exchange

    Chapters

    • Chapter 1, The Stone That Remembers. Defeat 100 monsters in any Glast Heim map and bring 100 Skel-Bone and 10 Cursed Ruby. Reward: Echo Lens, Legacy Emblem Lv1, 10 Legacy Shards.
    • Chapter 2, Knights Without a King. Sera opens a rift into an echo of old Glast Heim, solo or with your party (the leader opens it, 2 hours). Ser Corvin leads you through the great hall (3 waves), the west chapel, the east forge and the north barracks, then up to the throne hall to face Oathbreaker Valen. The echoes are tough: bring a party. Reward: 30 Legacy Shards.
    • Lost your Echo Lens? Talk to Sera with a free inventory slot and she makes a new one.
    • After the story the rift stays open: you can clear it once a day for 10~20 Legacy Shards (resets 04:00, see your quest window). You must be inside when Valen falls.

    Legacy Shard Exchange (Archivist Sera)

    Shards can't be traded. Exchanged items come unidentified and roll random options when you appraise them, so you can exchange again for a better roll.

    ItemSlotBonusShards

    Autohunt @ah

    Built-in auto attack. Your character explores, fights with your skills, drinks potions, teleports and loots. No bots needed (and bots are banned).

    3 hoursFree every day
    50%EXP, drops and Mastery EXP while autohunting
    OfflineLog out and keep hunting
    10 CP1 extra hour (Cash Shop)
    Read more: settings and limits
    OptionWhat it does
    Start / Stop / OfflineHunt on your current map. Offline logs you out; log in again to stop.
    Attack skillsUp to 3 skills, tried in order. Normal attack if none can be used.
    Buff skillsUp to 3 self buffs, recast when they run out.
    Auto potionOne HP and one SP potion, below the % you set.
    Auto teleportAfter 1-60 s with no monster. Teleport skill, Infinite Fly Wing, Fly Wing, or Auto.
    Crowd teleportTeleports when 2-30 monsters are within 3 cells.
    Ignore monstersSkip up to 20 monsters.
    MVPAvoid (default) or attack MVPs.
    AutolootEverything, ≤50/10/1/0.1%, custom %, or off.
    • Free time resets at midnight and is shared by your account and your computer.
    • Extra time: 1 h 10 CP, 5 h 35 CP, 24 h 150 CP. Bought time never expires.
    • Max 2 characters per computer autohunting, only 1 of them offline.
    • Avoids warp portals and doesn't steal other players' monsters. Shows an [AutoHunt] tag and blue aura.

    Weapon Mastery @wi

    Hunt with a weapon and its mastery levels up, up to Lv 128. Only the right-hand weapon counts.

    STR

    Onslaught

    Swords, spears, axes, maces, knuckles. Damage vs all, Base ATK, crit damage, splash at Lv 128.

    AGI

    Swiftness

    Daggers, katars, Fuuma, books. ASPD, move speed, Flee, Double Attack, HP drain at Lv 128.

    DEX

    Ranged

    Bows, instruments, whips, guns. Damage vs all, ranged damage, ASPD, +2 range at Lv 128.

    INT

    Mystical

    Rods, staves, some magic daggers/swords. MATK, magic damage, cast time, SP, no cast cancel at Lv 128.

    Read more: how leveling works
    • Mastery EXP comes from the Job EXP of your kills. Higher level weapons give more.
    • Party members on the map get 50% of your mastery EXP.
    • Bonuses scale with your base stat (STR/AGI/DEX/INT without gear).
    • The Weapon Mastery Guide (prontera 147,170) lists every bonus.

    Party MVP drop share

    Your party kills an MVP → every member on the map rolls the full MVP drop table for themselves. A 0.1% card is 0.1% for each of you.

    EveryoneGets their own drop roll
    ≤1%Rare drops announced server-wide
    50%Mastery EXP shared
    Read more
    • Works for quest and instance MVPs too, like Ktullanux and Thanatos Phantom.
    • Shared drops arrive unidentified. The killer keeps the normal drop.
    • Alts on the same computer don't get a roll.

    Damage Tester @dummy

    Test your build on training dummies in south-east Prontera. Talk to a Dummy Trainer to set up your booth.

    5Booths, 1-9 dummies each
    DPSTotal, DPS and best second
    10-180 sTimed tests, or free mode
    Read more
    • Set the dummy's size, race, element and level, Normal or Boss, level, DEF, MDEF, VIT, INT, AGI and LUK, or copy any monster by ID.
    • Dummies never die and never fight back. Damage is counted once per second.
    • Your settings are saved and can be loaded at any booth. A booth is yours until you leave it alone for 60 seconds.
    • Anyone hitting your dummies (also homunculus and summons) adds to the numbers.
